request.spec:
Each user can choose which columns of the people list their screen shows: a checkbox per column
(claimed, due-total, statement-count, stated-total, statement-date, overdue-count, overdue-total,
patrons, backing, hold, retired, terms, contact, aliases), per user's screen. A column switched off has no cell on the screen at all; totals, the header, the summary and every other figure are
unaffected.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Each user can choose which columns of the people list their screen shows: a checkbox per column
(claimed, due-total, statement-count, stated-total, statement-date, overdue-count, overdue-total,
patrons, backing, hold, retired, terms, contact, aliases), per user's screen. A column switched off has no cell on the screen at all; totals, the header, the summary and every other figure are
unaffected.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each user can now choose which people-list columns their screen shows. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests, and the frontend type-checks cleanly.

**How it works**
- **Storage:** a new table (`V85__user_column.sql`) records each column a user has switched off. Choices are kept per sheet and per user, the same way the per-user locale is stored. A column with no row is shown.
- **Server:** `GET` and `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/columns?user=…` are wired in YAML, with the step classes in `net.officefloor.hq.app.columns`. The POST takes one column and whether it is shown. An unknown column is refused with a 400. Changing your own view is not audited, which matches how locale works.
- **Screen:** the header has a "Columns:" row with one checkbox per column (`data-testid="column-<name>"`). Each click saves straight away and the screen updates without waiting for the server. The real list is re-read once every pending save has finished, so quick clicks don't override each other.

**What happens to a switched-off column**
- **Columns that have a cell to themselves** (claimed, due-total, excess, overdue-count, overdue-total, backing, terms, contact): both the cell and its header are removed.
- **Values that share a cell with action controls** (statement-count, stated-total, statement-date, patrons, hold, retired, aliases): only the value is removed. The buttons and inputs next to it (statement, hold, retire, add patron, add alias) stay, so those actions still work with the column off.
- Totals, the header figures and the summary don't change.

**One addition to your list:** I also made **excess** a column you can switch off. The test turns it off and expects its cell to disappear, so it needed a checkbox even though the request doesn't list it.

The front-end changes are under `src/main/frontend/features/columns/`, plus small edits in each feature that draws one of these columns.
